svg.text: Half-size breadboard, top view, 3V3 logic only. Hole = column number + row letter.
Rows a-e of a column are one strip, rows f-j another; rails run the full length.
Pico straddles the channel: pins 1-20 on row c (pin 1 at column 30), pins 21-40 on row h.
Rails: outer bar is 3V3, inner bar is GND, top and bottom 3V3 rails joined by one bridge.
UNVERIFIED: hole grid assumes a standard 0.1 in half-size board
UNVERIFIED: continuous rails assumed (some boards split them)
CLOCK IN: loop-back only, no external signals
UNVERIFIED: IIC/SPI pads, if any, in SPI position
UNVERIFIED: KY-040 header order, read silkscreen
R_A h1 K h2 G_A h3 B_A h4
GND c6 + c7 SW c8 DT c9 CLK c10
Pico: pin n at c(31-n) for n<=20, h(n-10) for n>=21
Length class: S up to 6 holes, M 7-14 holes, L longer
05 a14 GP13 > a8 ENC SW S
06 a11 GP15 > a9 ENC DT S
